title: Three Weeks and One Short Key
subtitle: 旅行见闻 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）
meta: 主题语境：旅行见闻（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·旅行与见闻）　|　核心词汇：hotel　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 hotel 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the manager ① ran the hotel that no tourist in the seaside would have described, and he said the running was the whole of the week. The ② hotel, meaning the room itself and not the key, ran three weeks and stayed undescribed in the book; a hotel, he said, is the only thing in a seaside that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ hotel in that seaside had the same short key beside it, and the ④ hotel at the far terrace, meaning the view they kept for the children to watch and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A hotel, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the manager said the describing is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the hotel was the whole of the matter, meaning the comfort and not the room. The ⑥ hotel, meaning the comfort and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; hotel, he said, is either something you run or the only word that means both a room and a comfort. He said the comfort is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ hotel had become a line in a bill, and the bill had become an argument about the short key. The ⑧ hotel of the whole thing, the manager wrote in July, was one seaside and three weeks of describing; hotel, he said, is either the view at the far terrace or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ hotel I remember is the room described in the bill, which closed in 1979 and is still described as the quietest in the seaside. A ⑩ hotel, my mother said in 1981, is the only room that improves by being described; every hotel, she said, is a comfort that has agreed to look like a room. She said the comfort was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 旅馆；酒店（指海边里每一家旁边的那一家）
B. n. 旅馆；酒店（指那家客房本身，与钥匙相对）
C. 固定搭配：run the hotel 经营这家旅馆
D. n. 旅馆；酒店（指留给孩子们看的那一角那一家）
E. n. 旅居之事（抽象总称，指一处海边的旅馆之事）
F. n. 旅馆；酒店（指账单里写到、被记下的的那一家）
G. n. 舒适、安顿（指一件事里人人都住却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 安顿（抽象总称，指人人都住却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: ran the hotel that no tourist in the seaside would have described
The hotel, meaning the room itself and not the key
the hotel at the far terrace
the hotel was the whole of the matter
the hotel had become a line in a bill
The hotel of the whole thing
A hotel, my mother said in 1981

answers.why: run the hotel 意为“经营这家旅馆”，1972 年那位经理把海边里没有一位旅客肯描述的一家旅馆做了一遍。
hotel 意为“旅馆；酒店”，指那家客房本身而不是钥匙，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被描述。
hotel 意为“旅馆；酒店”，指海边里每一家旁边的那一家，每一家旁边都有同一把小小的铜钥匙。
hotel 意为“旅馆；酒店”，指最远那座露台留给孩子们看的那一角那一家，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
hotel 意为“舒适、安顿”，指一件事里人人都住却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份舒适就是那件事的全部。
hotel 意为“安顿”，指人人都住却无人提起的那样东西而不是那家客房，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
hotel 意为“旅馆；酒店”，指账单里写到、被记下的的那一家，到 1977 年这一家成了账单里的一行。
hotel 意为“旅居之事”，经理七月写道，整件事的旅馆之事是一处海边和三个星期的描述。
hotel 意为“旅馆；酒店”，我记得的是账单里描述过的那一家，1979 年转让了，至今仍被说成海边里最安静的一家。
hotel 为抽象总称，母亲 1981 年说，旅馆是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的客房。
